# `webmaster` — `/api/webmaster`

Webmaster tools: bring a website into the file bank, to change it there and publish it.

| Method | Path | Who may call | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/webmaster/imports`](#get-api-webmaster-imports) | Webmaster | The last 10 website imports and how they went (webmasters). |
| POST | [`/api/webmaster/imports`](#post-api-webmaster-imports) | Webmaster | Starts copying a public website into a space's Website folder (webmasters who are members of the space; one import at a time). |
| POST | [`/api/webmaster/starter`](#post-api-webmaster-starter) | Webmaster | A one-page website for a Grove that has none yet, in Website/<the Grove's address>. |
| POST | [`/api/webmaster/unpack`](#post-api-webmaster-unpack) | Webmaster | A .zip in Files, such as a site that isn't online yet, unpacked into Website/<its name>. |

<a id="get-api-webmaster-imports"></a>
### `GET /api/webmaster/imports`

The last 10 website imports and how they went (webmasters).

- Handler: [`imports`](../../../backend/community/webmaster.py)
- Who may call: Grove owners and webmasters

**Response**

- `200`: JSON list, each item JSON object with the fields of a row of `site_imports`: `id`, `space_id`, `user_id`, `url`, `folder`, `status`, `added`, `changed`, `unchanged`, `skipped`, `bytes`, `notes`, `message`, `started`, `finished`, `space_name`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Only this Grove’s owners and webmasters can do this. | `webmaster` |

<a id="post-api-webmaster-imports"></a>
### `POST /api/webmaster/imports`

Starts copying a public website into a space's Website folder (webmasters who are members of the space; one import at a time).

- Handler: [`start_import`](../../../backend/community/webmaster.py)
- Who may call: Grove owners and webmasters who are members of the space

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `ImportBody`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes |  | at least 3 characters; at most 2000 characters |
| `space_id` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 64 characters |

**Response**

- `202`: JSON object with the fields of a row of `site_imports`: `id`, `space_id`, `user_id`, `url`, `folder`, `status`, `added`, `changed`, `unchanged`, `skipped`, `bytes`, `notes`, `message`, `started`, `finished`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Only this Grove’s owners and webmasters can do this. | `webmaster` |
| 404 | Space not found. | `membership` |
| 409 | An import is already running. Wait for it to finish. | `start_import` |
| 422 | Enter a web address like https://example.com. | `start_url` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 422 | Use a name of up to 200 characters, without slashes. | `clean_name` |
| 422 | the underlying error's message | `start_import` |

<a id="post-api-webmaster-starter"></a>
### `POST /api/webmaster/starter`

A one-page website for a Grove that has none yet, in Website/<the Grove's address>. When the space already has one, says where it is (existed) and leaves it as it is.

- Handler: [`starter`](../../../backend/community/webmaster.py)
- Who may call: Grove owners and webmasters who are members of the space

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `StarterBody`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `space_id` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 64 characters |

**Response**

- `201`: JSON object with `space_id`, `folder`, `existed`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Only this Grove’s owners and webmasters can do this. | `webmaster` |
| 404 | Space not found. | `membership` |
| 409 | the underlying error's message | `starter` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 422 | Use a name of up to 200 characters, without slashes. | `clean_name` |

<a id="post-api-webmaster-unpack"></a>
### `POST /api/webmaster/unpack`

A .zip in Files, such as a site that isn't online yet, unpacked into Website/<its name>. Unpacking again adds new versions of whatever changed and deletes nothing, as importing does.

- Handler: [`unpack`](../../../backend/community/webmaster.py)
- Who may call: Grove owners and webmasters who are members of the space

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `UnpackBody`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `space_id` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 64 characters |
| `file_id` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 64 characters |

**Response**

- `201`: JSON object with `space_id`, `folder`, the fields of `counts`, `bytes`, `skipped_files`, `message`, `has_index`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Only this Grove’s owners and webmasters can do this. | `webmaster` |
| 404 | File not found. | `live_item` |
| 404 | Space not found. | `membership` |
| 422 | Folders go 20 deep at most. | `clean_folder` |
| 422 | That file isn’t a .zip the Grove can open. | `unpack` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 422 | Use a name of up to 200 characters, without slashes. | `clean_name` |
